about: Spin & Strike puts you in control of a rolling bowling ball on tricky rotating platforms. Spin the platforms, dodge spikes, avoid moving obstacles, and aim to knock down all the pins. Grab the star on each level for extra points and keep the ball from falling off. Every twist and turn is full of tension, and one wrong move can send the ball to fall. Can you master the roll and strike them all?
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
